job.job_description:
Notice Period: Immediate Joiner

Experience: 4-8 years

Location: Gurgaon, 5 Days WFO

Project: BlackRock




If you meet the criteria, send your application at umang.jugran@vlinkinfo.com





Design, build, and maintain infrastructure and tooling for the TVAS remediation pipeline
Develop AI-assisted workflows to triage, prioritize, and support remediation of vulnerability/assessment findings
Build and integrate automation pipelines connecting AI tooling with existing enterprise/security systems
Collaborate with platform, security, and risk teams to translate remediation requirements into scalable technical workflows
Write clean, production-grade code in Java
Contribute to CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring of the remediation factory infrastructure
Troubleshoot and optimize performance of AI infrastructure components at scale

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in Java
Experience building AI/ML infrastructure, tooling, or automation pipelines
Familiarity with workflow orchestration and pipeline design
Understanding of software engineering best practices (testing, CI/CD, version control)
Ability to work independently in a distributed/offshore delivery model

Good to Have

Experience with LLM/GenAI frameworks (LangChain, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering)
Exposure to vulnerability management, security tooling, or risk/compliance systems
Cloud platform experience (AWS/Azure/GCP)
Experience working in BFSI or large enterprise environments
